examples.en: Which of the two spears shall I take? This one is heavy, and that one is sharp. Which do you want? I want the sharp one. A sharp spear breaks quickly. A heavy spear does not break. Then I will take the heavy one, and I will sharpen it. You have chosen wisely.

examples.en: It has not rained, the furrow has dried up, the grain does not grow. The wild beasts are thirsty, we are thirsty. We look up, do not leave us. Perkunos, will it not rain? We have grown tired, and our strength is gone.

examples.pie: sérpont HéHḱew h₂éngʷʰey lóyseh₂i l̥gʰdʰí. nu h₂ówins poh₂iménm̥-kʷe mē h₁r̥sḱés. nu ḱwṓ bʰéwdʰeti nu twé kʷéḱt. h₂epó sérpe nu bʰudʰménm̥ ní h₁idʰí. wih₁rós kʷis ǵʰwḗr-kʷe mē n̥ḱyéh₁t.
examples.en: Swift snake, creeping in the furrow, lie down! Do not go to the sheep or the shepherd. Now the dog is awake, he sees you. Creep away, now go down to the bottom. May no one be lost, man and beast alike.

examples.pie: ḱwónn̥s nékʷti ḱléws? h₁íns ḱlḗm h₂élbʰit-kʷe moy h₂usési lelóykʷe. bʰṓr gʷémt. h₁ésyo lóysās déh₂newi widóm. kúdʰe gʷéh₂t? dóruh₂ próti gʷéh₂t. bʰórm̥ sékʷōmesdʰh₂ h₁ím-kʷe h₁épomes. h₁éyomes. ǵʰoysóm toy kapyé.
examples.en: Did you hear the dogs in the night? I heard them, and at dawn my barley is gone. A thief came! I saw his tracks at the river. Where did he go? He went toward the trees. Let us follow the thief, and let us seize him. Let us go! Grasp your spear!
